steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Finally, I can catch my breath.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: I don't think I've talked so much in my entire life. And I've got another lifetime's worth of talking to do tomorrow.
Hah. How about we trade jobs, then?
I'll greet the Kazdelian delegation. You deal with the thirteen nomadic abbeys scheduled to arrive tomorrow. How's that?
All this running around is hard on my old bones.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: That will not be necessary, Reverend Patrizion.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: How is communicating with our new Sarkaz friends?

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Fine enough.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Not all the Sarkaz have set hatred aside. That ancient Revenant with Speaker Wiš'adel, for example, got rather worked up at the mere sight of the Matriarch.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: But the Speaker shut them up. She's been so magnanimous that I'm having trouble reconciling my impression with the rumors I've heard of her.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: The chief spokesman for the Kazdelian delegation is a Lich by the name of Fremont. I wish you could have seen it—

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: A three-hour debate in which he engaged seventeen cardinals from the First and Sixth Tribunals in a, well, 'animated exchange of opinions', encompassing everything from politics to the Law, from faith to life and death.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Small wonder that whole procession of cardinals was spotted around the guava juice machine afterwards. They must've been soothing their parched lips and throats.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Such energy at his age! I envy the man.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Long story short, Kazdel accepted our proposal. The Royal Court will review the legacy of royal authority, and the Sarkaz will unite through the mediation of Laterano.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: I have also spoken to the Empresses' Voice. The Leithanian delegation will arrive at the Holy City early tomorrow morning.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Now that's something you don't see every day.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Remember how few answered the call of the first Summit of Nations two years ago. Most thought that the Lateran Declaration was little more than a piece of paper, empty posturing.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Empress Ewigegnade declined our invitation then. This time, she is proactively asking to take part in the Summit of Nations.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Even Empress Grimmacht, who has long been out of the public eye, came out of seclusion to join the envoy and visit Laterano...

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: It's a strong show of good faith from Leithanien.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Shall we say the second Summit of Nations has already met expectations?

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Exceeded them, Cardinal Velliv.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Columbia, Ursus, Yan, even distant Ægir... all nations that should be here are now present.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: It's like a dream.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Only the inevitable result of Laterano's development over the ages.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: The prophesied calamity draws near. The black snow on the ice of Sami, the hole in the sky above Leithanien, even the raging tides that dash against the coast, are all portents of its inevitable arrival.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: In the face of calamity, everyone wants order—Lateran order.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: You're correct. But even after all our preparation, the sight still feels... unfamiliar.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: If it's like that for you, imagine how it must be for everyone else. Even if one has heard of the path that Laterano has paved in response to the prophesied calamity countless times during one's enlightenment...

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: One cannot help but hesitate when coming face-to-face with the ultimate end.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: What about yourself?

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: It's bad form to flaunt one's age, but when you get to be my age, there's not much to hesitate about.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Are you ready to retire?

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: I can hardly bite through a cactus tart these days. This summit may be the last thing I can do for Laterano.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: That might have more to do with your taste in food, Reverend... I would have a hard time biting through one of those, er, cactus tarts you're talking about.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: You are aware that all the cactus tarts among the refreshments were made specially for you? Literally no one else in all of Laterano has any interest in them.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: You must be joking. The cactus tarts were a recommendation from an old friend, a true connoisseur of desserts... what was his name again...?

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Doesn't matter. Back to the topic at hand.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: The doubts among the people make the subsequent ceremony at the Shrine of Nurtury all the more important.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: We must show everyone, in the most forceful manner, the potential of Laterano.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Of course. I'll get on the handover of the Seventh Tribunal immediately. When the Summit of Nations gets underway, I will head to the Shrine and ensure that the ceremony is executed without a hitch.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: No need to rush.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Hah. Never mind. Young people are all the same... they complain a lot, but they have no patience when the time for action comes.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Are you reminded of your Fia?

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: I believe she has returned, according to the mission logs?

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Yes. We'll have a family get-together tomorrow... I hope she likes my gift.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: The Shrine of Nurtury...

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: What a miracle.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Lemuen, Cardinal of the Seventh Tribunal. Go ahead.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Cardinal Lemuen, your presence is required at Via Jovita, Pagus Stevonus, to investigate a possible bombing.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Reverend Patrizion? I don't believe this was on today's schedule.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: You may not understand, as you were recently created, but emergency assignments take precedence over all other arrangements, regardless of organ.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: An emergency assignment...? But where did this decision come from? Is there any documentation to reference?

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Whether a situation is an emergency or not is always self-evident. There is no need for additional determination.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Someone of unknown identity and in possession of unregistered explosives has been seen in public multiple times without Notarial Hall oversight—

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: This is a grave threat to the order of Laterano. The centuries-long peace of the Holy City must not be broken by an illegal explosion during the Summit of Nations, with the eyes of all lands upon us.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: The suspect has been sighted on Via Jovita in Pagus Stevonus. You are the nearest officer of the Curia.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Proceed to the scene immediately. Your aide and Notarial Hall executors will join you, ETA approximately ten minutes following your arrival.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: ...Lemuen.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: What else do I need to know?

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: I had meant to congratulate you on your creation... but I guess it should wait for tomorrow's gathering.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Will you be there? We all know you've only gotten busier as your retirement draws near, and you always...

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Always put my duties first? I can't deny that.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: I've postponed meetings with old friends so many times that I can hardly remember their names, leaving me too embarrassed to meet them anymore.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: But I'll try to make the gathering tomorrow.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Take care, Reverend.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I'll head to Via Jovita immediately.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Can you hear me?
Lemuen?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I'm near the Shrine of Nurtury, but something just came up and I need to be elsewhere.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Did you say something? I couldn't make it out. Why are you whispering? You're not the type to keep your voice down.
(No no no, Lemuen, you misunderstand...)
(I'm fine, but there's a... situation. I need to stay hidden and keep quiet.)

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: See you at Fiammetta's thing, then.
(Sure.)
(Take care.)
Phew.

steps.name: Proud Child
steps.text: He's here! He might be whispering, but he can't fool my ears!

steps.name: Obstinate Child
steps.text: I didn't need you to guess where he is!

steps.name: Obstinate Child
steps.text: He's not behind the curtains or the pillars...

steps.name: Obstinate Child
steps.text: 'This wardrobe is only half his height. There's no way he could hide in here.'—Is what he'd want us to think!

steps.name: Proud Child
steps.text: What a dummy!

steps.name: Obstinate Child
steps.text: It's not that he's dumb, it's that we're too smart!

steps.name: Proud Child and Obstinate Child
steps.text: We found you, Senior Nurturer!

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Alright, alright, you got me—thirty extra minutes of free time today!

steps.name: Proud Child and Obstinate Child
steps.text: Yay!

steps.name: Proud Child
steps.text: Let's play 'Halo', Senior Nurturer!

steps.name: Proud Child
steps.text: I'll be the first to get in the bottle, the first one out the front, and the first one you hug! Then we'll hold hands and meet the other kids behind when they come out!

steps.name: Nurturer
steps.text: Are you bothering Andoain again, children?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: They just want to play a little longer. It's all fine. Giselle, Romya, go make your preparations at the Hall of Enlightenment. We can start the game once I get there, okay?

steps.name: Nurturer
steps.text: Don't you ever say no to the children?

steps.name: Nurturer
steps.text: I guess that's why they trust you and look up to you...

steps.name: Nurturer
steps.text: Just a few weeks ago, they were terrified of these unfamiliar halls. It was a struggle just to give them a change of clothes.

steps.name: Nurturer
steps.text: Now, they feel at home... all thanks to you.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: I didn't do anything, except stay with them.

steps.name: Nurturer
steps.text: You're very much like the Matriarch, down to your humility. Just having you with them makes all the difference.

steps.name: Nurturer
steps.text: Was it not your companionship that helped the mother you and the Matriarch brought back through the worst?

steps.name: Nurturer
steps.text: I remember the first thing the surgeon did after leaving the operating room was to check if he still had his halo.

steps.name: Nurturer
steps.text: He could not understand how the mother managed to survive with her baby, after her abdomen was impaled by a spear.

steps.name: Nurturer
steps.text: It was a miracle.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: We'll call it a miracle once she's successfully given birth. Meanwhile, I will continue to care for her as best as I can.

steps.name: Nurturer
steps.text: I'm... beginning to understand why the Matriarch holds you in such high regard. It is reassuring to know that you are in charge of the most important duty of the Nativity, the delivery of the child.

steps.name: Nurturer
steps.text: The Shrine of Nurtury will be ready for full operation if the Nativity goes well. Every child born on Terra henceforth shall have the protection and blessing of the Holy City.

steps.name: Nurturer
steps.text: That will be the true miracle.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: I hope so... I do hope so.

steps.name: Nurturer
steps.text: I must not keep you any longer. Giselle and Romya are still waiting for you!
Via Jovita, Pagus Stevonus

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: It's quiet...
A procession of halos stretches from one end of the street to the other. No one stops, and there is no commotion.
Someone may step out of the procession to enter a passing confessional, or pick up an ice cream cone from a dessert cart, before continuing on their soundless parade.
Silence and order. This is how things have always been in Laterano, the Holy City.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I'm in position.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Identifying suspicious personnel. No unusual activity at this time.
A figure flashes by a corner in the distance. The wind blows her hood open briefly, revealing a streak of bright red.
